zh: 先看两个中心和两个目的地的小例子：交叉配对和按大小顺序配对，哪个总距离更小？
对 a≤b、x≤y，有 |a−x|+|b−y| ≤ |a−y|+|b−x|，所以任何交叉都能交换掉而不变差，最优方案就是按排序后的位置一一配对。
两组坐标分别排序，累加第 i 小的中心与第 i 小的目的地之差的绝对值；总和可能超过 32 位。
en: Look at two centers and two destinations: which is shorter in total, a crossing pairing or pairing them in sorted order?
For a≤b and x≤y, |a−x|+|b−y| ≤ |a−y|+|b−x|, so any crossing can be swapped away without getting worse; the optimum pairs elements by sorted position.
Sort both lists and sum the absolute differences between the i-th smallest center and the i-th smallest destination; the total can exceed 32 bits.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort both coordinate lists and pair the elements at the same sorted position.

## Proof of correctness

For a≤b and x≤y, |a−x|+|b−y|≤|a−y|+|b−x|. Hence any crossing pair can be swapped into an order-preserving pair without increasing the cost; removing inversions repeatedly yields the sorted pairing.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
